expectation: Membrane (junctional) ring staining on epithelial cells, honeycomb or chicken-wire outlines lining glands and crypts in this gut-like tissue. Stroma and lymphoid cells should be negative. Common, since epithelium is abundant.
observed: A: yellow signal covers the epithelial folds and glands, and the stroma and background are dark. B and C: crisp lateral membrane outlines on columnar cells, lining a gland lumen. D: a cell-border mesh around nuclei. E: membrane lines on the epithelial sheets, with panCK diffuse and hazy. Bright blobs are debris.
why: The sharp junctional membrane outlines on epithelial glands, with stroma negative, are the expected Ecadherin pattern.
